latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "customer-success-onboarder" skill for SaaS onboarding coaching.
- Diagnoses, fixes, and designs onboarding flows to improve trial conversion, activation, and reduce early churn.
- Covers onboarding models for self-serve, low-touch, mid-touch, and high-touch SaaS, with practical benchmarks and best practices.
- Includes templates for onboarding flows, email sequences, kickoff call planning, CSM playbooks, and customer health scoring.
- Adapts recommendations for B2C, B2B-SMB, mid-market, and enterprise SaaS contexts.
